location.zh: 卡酷星丛林（天界秘境入口）

capture.zh: 在卡酷星丛林（天界秘境入口，可由SPT直接传送）挑战阿加莎，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 海洋之心+暴击流（布鲁克克/布林克克海洋之心后谱尼等收尾）或秒杀流（魔焰猩猩绝命火焰）。

engine_notes: drain_each_turn: every turn the player's active pet loses a flat 100 HP and the boss heals 100 HP; once the boss is below 50% HP this becomes 200/200.
No innate boost; 绿光冲击 clears the player's boosts; 藤蔓抽打 15% fear.
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2012-01-10, 常用技能) and equal species 1061's last four learnt at or below Lv80.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
Immune to 烧伤、冻伤、中毒 and control (灵魂干涉 and the like); 海洋之心 works (7k7k 2012-01-06).
source_note: 4399 SPT page dated 2012-01-10: 80级, 约8000血; drain aura 100/200.
